module.title: Unix system module
module.description: Various system related checks, such as CPU load, process state and memory.
module.name: CheckSystem

commands.check_cpu: Check that the load of the CPU(s) are within bounds.

check_load.description: Check the system load average (1/5/15 minutes).

check_cpu_utilization.description: Check CPU utilization broken down by user/system/iowait/steal/guest.

commands.check_uptime: Check time since last server re-boot.
commands.check_memory: Check free/used memory on the system.
commands.check_os_version: Check the version of the underlying OS.

check_os_updates.description: Check for available OS package updates via the system package manager (apt/dnf/yum/zypper/pacman).

check_installed_software.description: Check installed software packages via the system package manager (dpkg/rpm/pacman): inventory, unwanted/EOL software policy and recent-install detection.

check_hostname.description: Check host identity: hostname, canonical FQDN and DNS domain, with drift detection for the name mismatches that silently break auth and monitoring.

check_kernel_memory.description: Check kernel memory-manager health: slab bytes (reclaimable/unreclaimable), page-cache bytes and page-fault rates — the kernel-leak and fault-storm signals free-RAM thresholds miss.

commands.check_pagefile: Check the size of the system pagefile(s).
commands.check_service: Check the state of one or more of the computer services.
commands.check_process: Check state/metrics of one or more of the processes running on the computer.

check_cpu_frequency.description: Check the CPU clock frequency (current vs max) per core.

check_battery.description: Check battery charge level, power source and health.

check_network.description: Check network interface status and throughput.

check_process_history.description: Check the history of processes seen since NSClient++ started (requires 'process history = true').

check_process_history_new.description: Check for processes first seen within a recent time window (requires 'process history = true').

check_kernel_stats.description: Check kernel activity: context-switch rate, fork rate and live thread count.

check_swap_io.description: Check the swap in/out paging rate.
